annotations.title: Ask to be told when a publication is available

description: Asks Opedd to tell you when a publication it does not carry yet becomes available to license. Use it after lookup_content says an article is not on Opedd. Records the request against the email given; nothing is bought. If the publication is already on Opedd, returns its licensing page instead. Free; no key needed.

email.description: Where Opedd should write when the publication is available (the user's email, with their consent).

note.description: Optional: what the content is needed for (max 1000 characters).

organization.description: Optional: the requester's company or fund.

url.description: The web address of the publication or of one of its articles.

name: request_publication
title: Ask to be told when a publication is available
